description: For a surjective list f : ℕ → A, the least-occurrence code c(a) is injective, satisfies f(c(a)) = a, and no earlier index maps to a.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.firstOccurrence_spec.{u} {α : Type u} (f : ℕ → α) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
  Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.firstOccurrence f hf) ∧
    ∀ (a : α),
      f (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.firstOccurrence f hf a) = a ∧ ∀ n < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.firstOccurrence f hf a, f n ≠ a
